title: Queen of the flies 蝇后
description:
This is a reading game that describes internet life. You can push the plot by clicking on different positions on the screen and pass the customs in 30 minutes.







Game play:



Click the mouse to trigger different plots by clicking on different positions on the screen, and finally usher in the end of the story.







Game content:



1. 15K word plot text, a concise short story.



2. 7 original music, which will change with the advance of the plot.



3. Novel visual novel, all words can interact.



4. A profound core to expose the essence of the Internet to you.







Note:



1. This is not a fun game. It can't bring you happiness, and may even bring you pain.



2. This is a game with many words. Before starting the game, please make sure you are used to or good at reading.
